prompts.name: process
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE finished high fidelity 3D navigation icon for the charcoal sidebar of Drumvault, a professional music app.
Style: an exquisitely crisp physically rendered miniature 3D object, premium industrial design, machined beveled edges, satin anodized metal and polished ceramic enamel, controlled luminous highlights, realistic thickness, subtle self-shadow and ambient occlusion, immaculate anti-aliasing, rendered like an expensive product shot. Refined modern macOS-quality icon artwork, sophisticated rather than toy-like. Key light from upper left, soft cool rim light on right. Near-front orthographic view with modest top and right faces visible. Broad readable forms, few details, excellent legibility when reduced to 32px. Centered isolated object occupying roughly 82% of a square canvas, entire object comfortably inside canvas.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including all negative space and holes. No background square, no squircle, no enclosing tile, no app badge, no circle backdrop, no base plate, no plinth, no enclosing frame, no floor, no cast ground shadow, no glow cloud, no solid white or black background, no checkerboard drawn into image.
Constraints: render exactly the subject specified, one standalone icon, no lettering, no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI mockup, no extra ornament. Match the stated material, framing and lighting consistently with a family of other sidebar icons.
Subject: A thick downward import arrow made of satin champagne gold, floating just above a small open U-shaped receiving tray also in gold. The tray is the actual receiving object, NOT a surrounding tile. The arrow shaft and broad arrowhead have beautifully machined bevels, a bright pale-gold top-left edge and rich amber sidewalls. Simple unmistakable import/process silhouette.
